name: fable-advisor
description: Run your session on Opus as a full-time architect: it writes specs and verdicts, GPT-5.6 Sol at high reasoning (via Codex) does the routine typing, Fable 5 handles the high-complexity one-offs — and reviews every deliverable before it ships. This fork adds six task classes, five named exceptions for keeping work Claude-side, a Haiku floor lane, and quota failover between the two subscriptions.
